route: /style-board/ (the style board: module process:circles, longest and shortest copy, photos as grey frames; no competitor section shows this module)

findings.issue: The process section heading ('OEM Bikini Sampling, Lead Times, Payment and Shipping' and 'Trial Runs') is centred over an intro paragraph and step columns that start on the left edge, so heading and copy in one section align differently and the site's left-edge heading rule is broken.
findings.reference: The site's layout rule: every section heading starts on the content's left edge, even where a module would centre it; the competitor has no circles module to say otherwise.
findings.fix: In patterns.css, drop `text-align: center` from `.process__heading` (set `text-align: start`) so the heading sits on the left edge with its lead and steps.

findings.issue: On phones the three-line heading 'OEM Bikini Sampling, / Lead Times, Payment / and Shipping' (and 'Trial Runs') is centred with ragged lines above a left-aligned lead and left-aligned step list.
findings.reference: Section headings start on the content's left edge at every width (site rule).
findings.fix: Same change: `.process__heading { text-align: start; }` in patterns.css.

findings.issue: Step titles ('Enquiry and quotation', 'Send your first-run plan') are set at regular weight 400, barely larger than the step text, so the steps have no visible heading level under the section heading.
findings.reference: The competitor's sub-headings and card titles are Maison 700 (e.g. card title 700 22px/33px, h3 700), clearly heavier than the body copy.
findings.fix: In reference.css add `.block--process .process-step__title { font-weight: 700; }` (weight only, size stays with the template's --size-subheading).

findings.issue: On phones the step titles are the same size and weight as the step text below them, so each step reads as two body paragraphs under its number circle.
findings.reference: The competitor's step and card titles are bold (700), set apart from their text.
